record.question: What is India's rank in the 2017 world economic forum's Global Gender Gap Index?
record.explanation: Answer C: 108. India ranked 108 th in the Global Gender Gap Index 2017. The World Economic Forum’s own original 2017 release explicitly gives India 108. Historical/source note: 2017 index edition, not a current rank. Reference: https://www.weforum.org/media/ten-years-of-progress-on-global-gender-parity-stalls-in-2017. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
